content: Upon reception of a UDS Service ClearDiagnosticInformation (0x14) request with parameter groupOfDTC, the Dcm module shall call the API Dem_SelectDTC() with the following parameter values: • ClientId: Client Id for this Dcm instance (see DcmDemClientRef ) • DTC: groupOfDTC from the service request • DTCFormat: DEM_DTC_FORMAT_UDS • DTCOrigin: DEM_DTC_ORIGIN_PRIMARY_MEMORY
